verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official MCP server for Cloud Run resources, with a first-party GitHub repo for deploying apps to Cloud Run. Google also ships MCP Toolbox for Databases, an open-source MCP server under googleapis that connects Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients to databases. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections, evidence of MCP coverage beyond Cloud Run and databases (e.g., a platform-wide MCP endpoint)
